name: docs_tutorials_05
source:
{ Mass-spring-damper: ring-down, accessors, and Bode -- Tutorial 1 }
m = 2 [kg]
k = 800 [N/m]
c = 8 [N-s/m]
wn   = sqrt(k / m)
zeta = c / (2 * sqrt(k * m))

DYNAMIC msd (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 5, points = 500)
  der(x) = v
  der(v) = -(c/m) * v - (k/m) * x
  energy = 0.5*m*v^2 + 0.5*k*x^2
  x(0) = 0.05
  v(0) = 0
END

x_peak  = MaxValue('x')
t_cross = TimeAt('x', 0)
E_final = FinalValue('energy')

num = [1]
den = [m, c, k]
omega[1:400] = linspace(0.5, 100, 400)
CALL bode(num, den, omega : mag, phase)

PLOT 'MSD Bode'
  kind = bode
  omega = omega
  mag = mag
  phase = phase
END
